amends: the network architecture again (supersedes amendment 9's shared trunk); the task, world, reward, observation and acceptance criteria are untouched
when: after the per-leg diagnostic runs, before the mixed-leg run

evidence.single_leg_training_works: with sampling restricted to one leg, the left front leg reached all five criteria at update 16 and held them at update 32 (lift 0.727, advance 0.540, final load 0.448, body height 1.250); the left middle and right middle legs each reached all five at update 8 in their own runs
evidence.but_it_destroys_the_other_five: in the same runs every other leg degrades to 'place only' with lift exactly 0.0000, because the six output heads still share one trunk and the trunk moves under one head's gradient
evidence.mixed_training_never_exceeded_three: six mixed-leg arms landed between 1 and 3 of 6, which is what one trunk pulled by six objectives would produce
evidence.diagnosis: the remaining conflict is inside the network, not between the network and the task

architecture_change.old: shared trunk (495->128->128) plus six 42-joint output heads
architecture_change.new: six fully independent sub-networks (495->128->128->42 each) selected by the leg prompt, plus ONE shared value function on the observation
architecture_change.value_function: the critic now has its own small trunk (495->128->1); previously it borrowed the actor's trunk, which is no longer shared
architecture_change.gradient_isolation: a sample for leg L updates only sub-network L and the value function; verified: gradients for the other five sub-networks are exactly zero
architecture_change.gradient_check: checked against a three-point central difference for both the actor head (w2 entry 5,7 of leg 2) and the critic (wc0 entry 3,4): analytic and numeric agree to six decimals. Note that two earlier checks of mine divided a one-sided difference by two epsilon and appeared to disagree by a factor of two; both were mistakes in the check, not in the code
architecture_change.declared_limit: independent per-leg sub-networks cannot coordinate legs by construction, so this is explicitly NOT a walking architecture and no result from it may be described as walking

unchanged.observation: 495 dimensions with the declared clearance channels
unchanged.reward: achievement-flag potential with aligned swing gates
unchanged.teacher: three phase demonstration, raise 60 / swing 90 / hold 0.5 (amendment 8)
unchanged.budget: 3600 imitation samples, 1500 imitation steps, 24 updates, 300 ticks

preregistered_outcomes: four or more legs passing in one mixed-leg run means the conflict was inside the network and the single-leg step task is solved for those legs by a replacement ANN in the derived world
fewer than four means the conflict is not only representational, and the report must give the per-leg criteria again
no result may be described as walking, as connectome capability or as frozen-body acceptance
discipline: all earlier preregistrations and amendments are left byte-identical. This is the eleventh documented change of the round and the report lists all eleven with their measurements.
